name: theme-registry
body: Theme registry: project themes (one directory per theme under the resolved library's `themes/<name>/`) mapping to their `theme.css` and files, registered by the template-library-loader; lookup by deck config, omitted theme resolves to `default`; unknown = error listing project themes. No built-in theme. A theme's `theme.css` — and any CSS it `@import`s from its own theme directory — may carry reserved `media:` references into the resolved library's shared `media/` tree (validated by the loader, theme-media-references); the theme registry serves the raw theme files and the HTTP server rewrites those references to served media URLs at serve time.
